world.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original premium Egyptian treasure game background, cinematic wide landscape about 2:1, 2048 pixels wide if possible.
Primary request: a richly atmospheric ancient Egyptian temple treasure chamber, colossal worn sandstone pillars, lapis-blue and antique gold inlays, warm lamps and shafts of pale desert moonlight through high stone openings. On the FAR RIGHT stands a magnificent sculptural gold-and-lapis pharaoh funerary guardian bust, serene handsome stylized face, striped deep-blue and gold nemes headdress and detailed broad jeweled collar. Original imagined design, not an exact copy of any existing artifact or commercial game character.
Composition: the central-left 70 percent is quiet shadowed chamber space, deep lapis and smoke-blue shadows with softly modeled temple stone and dim distant golden treasure, suitable behind a dominant rectangular reel board. Architecture frames only far left and far right, not a baked-in central arch. The main majestic guardian occupies rightmost 25 percent, upper body and ENTIRE tall headdress visible with generous top margin. Gold surfaces catch warm lamp light and cool moon rim. Very fine floating dust creates volumetric depth. A glimpse of pale desert and distant pyramid through a small far-right opening, not behind board. No bright clutter in central region.
Style: outstanding hand-painted 2.5D cinematic game concept art, tactile ancient engraved gold, weathered limestone, jewel-like lapis/carnelian/malachite, realistic sculptural modeling, mature sense of mystery and treasure. Palette deep midnight lapis, antique gold, warm sandstone, restrained carnelian red accents, no neon.
Constraints: no text, lettering, legible hieroglyphic inscriptions, numbers, logo, watermark, UI, reels, grid, slot machine or central board frame. No copied provider artwork. Original wide environment only, no thick cartoon outlines or flat vector look.

atlas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original premium Egyptian treasure game sprite atlas on TRUE transparent alpha. Landscape 4:3 canvas ideally 2048x1536. Exactly TWELVE separate complete symbols in FOUR columns × THREE rows, equal imaginary square cells, wide transparent gutters. Cell centers x12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y16.67%,50%,83.33%. Each icon centered at 65% maximum cell dimension, no overlap, no drawn grid.
Style: magnificent hand-painted 2.5D volumetric antique treasure illustration, sculptural realistic material modeling, finely engraved ancient gold, deep lapis enamel, carnelian red and malachite green, warm upper-left lamp light and subtle cold blue rim. Crisp distinct silhouettes legible at 40px. Original designs, not copied commercial game artwork. No flat vectors, emoji, thick cartoon outlines or cheap plastic.
Exact reading order:
Row1 col1: golden pharaoh mask bust, serene sculptural face, striped lapis-blue and gold nemes headdress, small cobra brow ornament and jeweled broad collar, full headdress contained.
Row1 col2: sculptural Eye of Horus pendant in warm antique gold and rich lapis-blue enamel, bold horizontal silhouette, no chain.
Row1 col3: ornate antique gold ankh with turquoise center, tall rounded loop and broad arms, carved material depth.
Row1 col4: glossy black stone jackal/Anubis head and upper collar, long upright ears, gold trim, blue-and-gold collar, strong black/gold silhouette.
Row2 col1: sculptural gilded falcon portrait with ivory/gray feathers, strong hooked beak, jeweled blue collar, no background.
Row2 col2: elegant open lotus blossom in pale ivory and deep teal enamel, gold petal edges, compact symmetrical silhouette.
Row2 col3: large faceted blue lapis gem with tiny gold flecks, hexagonal silhouette, no metal frame.
Row2 col4: large translucent red-orange carnelian gem, diamond silhouette, no metal frame.
Row3 col1: large polished green malachite gem with natural dark bands, square rounded silhouette, no metal frame.

Row3 col3: engraved heavy gold sun-disk wild medallion with deep blue center and small cobra ornament above, blank center for native wild word, no text.
Row3 col4: antique gold treasure coin with an ornamental circular Egyptian lotus rim and broad blank warm ivory center for native numeric value, no number.
